name: Exp_Fractal_RSI
summary: This EA combines Fractal breakout signals with RSI momentum filtering to generate trade entries. It identifies fractal highs and lows as support/resistance levels, then uses RSI to confirm momentum direction before opening positions. The strategy aims to capture trend continuation moves following fractal breakouts validated by RSI readings.
summary_zh: 该EA结合分形突破信号与RSI动量过滤来产生交易入场。它识别分形高低点作为支撑阻力位，然后使用RSI确认动量方向后开仓。策略旨在捕捉经RSI验证的分形突破后的趋势延续行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是基于威廉分形（Williams Fractal）突破与RSI动量指标的双重确认入场系统。分形向上突破表示价格突破前高阻力，分形向下突破表示价格跌破前低支撑。入场条件为：多头入场需价格向上突破分形高点且RSI高于设定阈值（如50或更高），确认上升动量；空头入场需价格向下跌破分形低点且RSI低于设定阈值，确认下降动量。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或反向分形信号触发平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA支持固定手数交易，部分版本可能包含基于账户余额的比例仓位计算。资金管理方面，依赖止损单控制单笔风险，但缺乏整体组合风险控制和最大回撤限制机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is a dual-confirmation entry system based on Williams Fractal breakout combined with RSI momentum filtering. An upside fractal breakout indicates price has broken above a prior swing high resistance, while a downside fractal breakout indicates price has broken below a prior swing low support. Entry conditions: long entry requires price breaking above a fractal high with RSI above a configured threshold (e.g., 50 or higher) confirming upward momentum; short entry requires price breaking below a fractal low with RSI below a configured threshold confirming downward momentum. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or position closure triggered by opposing fractal signals. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, with some versions potentially including balance-based proportional sizing. Money management relies on stop-loss orders for per-trade risk control but lacks portfolio-level risk management and maximum drawdown limits.

pros: 双指标确认机制（分形+RSI）减少了假突破信号，提高了入场质量
分形突破本质上是跟随趋势的策略，在趋势行情中表现良好
策略逻辑清晰易懂，参数可调性强，便于优化和回测
pros_en: Dual-indicator confirmation (Fractal + RSI) reduces false breakout signals and improves entry quality
Fractal breakout is inherently trend-following, performing well in trending markets
Clear and understandable strategy logic with highly adjustable parameters, facilitating optimization and backtesting
cons: 震荡行情中分形突破频繁失效，容易产生连续止损
RSI作为动量过滤器可能滞后，导致入场时机偏晚错过部分利润
缺乏资金管理和最大持仓控制，连续亏损时风险敞口不可控
cons_en: Fractal breakouts frequently fail in ranging markets, leading to consecutive stop-loss hits
RSI as a momentum filter may lag, causing late entries and missing part of the move
Lacks money management and maximum position control, leaving risk exposure uncontrolled during losing streaks
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整风险参数
增加最大回撤限制和最大连续亏损次数控制，提升资金安全性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that adapt to market volatility for better risk parameter adjustment
Add maximum drawdown limit and maximum consecutive loss count control to improve capital safety

risk_points: 分形突破在震荡市中假信号较多，缺乏行情状态过滤器
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，低波动时止损过大高波动时止盈过小
risk_points_en: Fractal breakouts produce many false signals in ranging markets without a market regime filter
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for volatility changes—stop too wide in low volatility, take-profit too tight in high volatility

The strategy aims to capture trend continuation moves following fractal breakouts validated by RSI readings.
